## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI or UX improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or dependency change

## Validation

List the commands and device or emulator checks you ran.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before-and-after evidence for meaningful UI changes, if applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository's existing style.
- [ ] Tests or relevant checks pass locally.
- [ ] Accessibility, empty states, and permission-denied paths were considered.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] No generated build outputs, secrets, or local signing keys are included.
